mechanism: Asset-light franchise fees, supply-chain economics and unit growth can convert recurring pizza demand into operating cash flow and shareholder returns if franchisee economics, comparable sales, debt service and reinvestment remain healthy.
catalyst: Comparable sales reaccelerate, unit growth remains disciplined, franchisee cash returns improve, operating cash conversion covers debt service and reinvestment, and leverage declines without impairing distributions.
invalidation: Comparable sales and unit economics weaken structurally; franchisees retrench; competition, food or labor costs impair store returns; leverage rises; or distributions exceed durable free cash flow after reinvestment.
